name: powerbi-engineering
description: Comprehensive Power BI solution auditing and maintainable SQL, Power Query, DAX, semantic-model, and PBIR engineering, plus the in-house report design blueprint. Performs detailed, correctness-first audits across sources, SQL, Power Query, semantic models, DAX, security, refresh, and PBIR reports; produces evidence-backed findings and exact optimization guidance, safely applies explicitly approved findings with validation and rollback, and builds or restyles report pages to the house visual system.

interface.shortDescription: Full Power BI auditing and engineering.
interface.longDescription: Performs detailed, correctness-first audits across sources, SQL, Power Query, semantic models, DAX, security, refresh, and PBIR reports. Produces evidence-backed findings and exact optimization guidance, and safely applies explicitly approved findings with validation and rollback. Audit and remediation skills are explicit-only: invoke them as $powerbi-solution-audit and $powerbi-remediate.
defaultPrompt: Run a comprehensive end-to-end audit of this Power BI project.
Deeply review and optimize this project's SQL, Power Query, and DAX.
Trace report usage and dependencies before recommending cleanup.
Implement the approved audit roadmap as a readable, maintainable PBIP.
